revision_scope: Fix pass 1. Runtime implementation is 6896c88, API artifact hashes are 9756fce, and the adapted stale-write unit fixture is 4072afe. Exact-head focused and touched-package runs use tested_revision. Race/API start revisions are recorded individually; their relevant runtime/contract sources match tested_revision. Only this report is committed after tested_revision.

scope_items.change: Every occupancy interval has starts_at, ends_at and all_day. The flag is the sole widening of 2h times-only disclosure; no event, matter, kind, attendee or video metadata is exposed. REST, MCP, kit types and real-core fixture agree.

Walled events with no active attendee produce the same restricted interval for wall members and other authorized callers, on REST/MCP. Unwalled unassigned events retain the requested-user filter; detail reads retain walls. Active attendee assignment and reactivation behavior remain unchanged.

Active-user validation applies only to new or changed hosts. Unrelated title/time/meeting edits and an explicitly unchanged host survive deactivation; clearing then reassigning an inactive host fails. Video omission preserves; null clears; objects merge supplied fields. Requested is required on create and optional on PATCH. Field null clears it (requested resets to false). Postgres row locking serializes read/merge/write plus audit across independent services; concurrent provider and meeting-id updates both survive. OpenAPI, MCP, docs and public CalendarVideoPatch agree. Provider is null or uses the shared manifest module-id syntax: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9]$, 2 to 42 ASCII characters. Invalid slugs/types and the overlength boundary fail; null and 2/42-character ids succeed.

Both frame bridges use live authenticated resolution for cross-module targets. Enabled source/target, staff viewer, declared staff tab and an approved link in either direction are required. Query and message params are filtered against target tabs[].params. Unlinked/disabled/client-tab/widget/external/traversal targets are refused; current same-module/core refusals are retained. Matter-placement linked tabs retain matter_id from query or message params even without a declaration, only for an existing matter the viewer can read. Missing/malformed/inaccessible matter context is refused. Other undeclared params are filtered. The resolved URL opens the real tab page.
